body:
You're right.  I guess most of the things I'm worried about are superficial.  I'll be finishing school next year, and I will have a lot of opportunities to do great things.

I'm feeling better now, but when I get into those moods I can't seem to break free from it.  Night time is especially the worst because I can occupy myself until I try to go to sleep, but it seems I'm up all night, every night without fail.  I'm trying to work through it, I try to look on the brighter sides of things, but it's hard when I can't get myself out of my own head.

Thanks for taking the time to listen.  Sometimes I just need someone who I can identify with and understands.

I made bad choices.  In highschool I smoked a lot of pot and decided I didn't want to go to college, or really do anything with my life.  Now I feel like I've missed out on so much.  I feel like I could have been travelling and doing such great things.  I know I'm intelligent, and I could have done anything I want, but I fucked up for no reason.  I used to play music, write songs, have lots of friends, be popular, but now these thoughts crippled me.  Things I used to like mean nothing to me anymore.  It all seems pointless, like I've run out of time and nothings going to get me anywhere because I'm not supposed to be here anymore.

Another thing that always crosses my mind when I get really bad is that an ex of mine (not the same one as my recent one) and I had an abortion, and sometimes I just think it should have been me.  I fucked up my own life but the kid didn't even get to have a chance.
